clubs.name: theCourseForum
clubs.description: A student-run product and engineering community building theCourseForum for UVA students. Members contribute to web features, review moderation, and community projects.

clubs.name: Virginia Entrepreneurship Organization
clubs.description: A student community for founders, builders, and aspiring investors. VEO hosts pitch nights, founder conversations, and small-group startup projects.

clubs.name: Hoo Hacks
clubs.description: UVA's student-run hackathon organization. The team designs workshops, mentorship programs, and a spring hackathon open to students across majors.

clubs.name: UVA Club Running
clubs.description: A welcoming running community with weekly social runs, track workouts, and regional race trips. No tryout is required to join.

clubs.name: Virginia Belles
clubs.description: A student a cappella group performing across Grounds and around Charlottesville. Auditions are held at the start of each semester.

clubs.name: Madison House
clubs.description: A student-run community service organization connecting UVA students with local nonprofits, schools, and community partners.

clubs.name: Camp Kesem at UVA
clubs.description: A student-run camp for children whose families are affected by cancer. Members plan year-round programming and a week of summer camp.

clubs.name: UVA Salsa Club
clubs.description: Social dance classes and practice nights for beginner and experienced salsa dancers. No partner or prior experience required.

clubs.name: Alpha Phi Omega
clubs.description: A co-ed service fraternity focused on leadership, friendship, and service. Members complete weekly service projects with local partners.

clubs.name: Virginia Women in Computer Science
clubs.description: A community for women and allies in computing. VWCS hosts technical workshops, mentorship circles, and industry conversations.

clubs.name: Mock Trial at UVA
clubs.description: A competitive mock trial team that practices case analysis, public speaking, and tournament advocacy. Tryouts are held in the fall.

clubs.name: Club Tennis at UVA
clubs.description: Competitive and recreational tennis for UVA students, with practices, ladders, and regional club tournaments.

clubs.name: Best Buddies UVA
clubs.description: A friendship and inclusion program pairing UVA students with community members with intellectual and developmental disabilities.

clubs.name: UVA Habitat for Humanity
clubs.description: Student volunteers build alongside local Habitat affiliates and support housing justice through education and fundraising.

clubs.name: Engineers Without Borders UVA
clubs.description: Student engineering teams partner with community organizations on sustainable infrastructure projects and technical education.

clubs.name: Phi Delta Epsilon
clubs.description: A co-ed pre-medical fraternity offering peer mentorship, clinical exposure, and service opportunities for students pursuing health careers.

clubs.name: Chinese Student Association
clubs.description: A community for students interested in Chinese culture, with cultural celebrations, food events, and peer support.

clubs.name: Black Student Alliance
clubs.description: An advocacy and community organization supporting Black students at UVA through programming, mentorship, and campus partnerships.
